responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend utility for base62 integer encoding. This header exposes the base62_integer helper that turns a uint64_t into a compact base62 string, so other frontend components can reuse the same short textual encoding when constructing identifiers or other generated names.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reusable base62_integer utility for other Rust frontend code; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-base62.cc, it does not define the encoding alphabet or conversion steps, only the interface.
